info.name: 1. Auth Service API - Complete Collection
info.description: Postman collection for Auth Service API. Includes: Registration (firstName, lastName), Login, Logout, Refresh, OTP, Profile, Soft Self-Delete, Password, Credentials, Admin (Decrypt, Users, Audit), T&C, Project Types. Swagger: auth-service/docs/swagger/auth_openapi.yaml. Base URL: localhost:8080

request.description: Register new user. Requires acceptTc, countryCode. Optional: firstName, lastName, pincode, city, state, country, address1-3
Register admin user. Same schema as RegisterRequest. Optional: firstName, lastName
LoginRequest: loginType PASSWORD (required), username, password. Optional: deviceInfo
LoginRequest: loginType MPIN, userId, mpin, deviceInfo
Logout current session. Uses Bearer token to revoke session. Alternative: send refreshToken in body { "refreshToken": "..." }
Logout using refresh token. Works when access token expired. Body: { "refreshToken": "{{refreshToken}}" }
Logout from all devices. Requires Bearer token. Query: all=true
Send OTP. Required: userId, channel (SMS|EMAIL|WHATSAPP), purpose (LOGIN|RESET_PASSWORD|CHANGE_MOBILE|CHANGE_EMAIL). Optional: mobile, email, templateCode, projectType, type
Get user by ID (admin or self)
Logged-in user: Get own profile with full decrypted (unmasked) PII. Same structure as extended profile.

variable.description: username, email, mobile, firstName, lastName, employeeId, pincode, city, state, country, address1, address2, address3, countryCode, dateOfBirth, gender, occupation, education, maritalStatus, profilePhotoUrl, linkedinUrl, facebookUrl, twitterUrl, instagramUrl, githubUrl, websiteUrl, preferences, activityPatterns, interests, bio, skills, languages, timezone, additionalInfo

request.description: Decrypt one field at a time. Call repeatedly for each field. Returns { field, decryptedValue }. Change :field to email, username, mobile, firstName, lastName, etc.
Update own profile. UserProfileRequest: firstName, lastName, pincode, city, state, country, address1-3 (all optional). Restricted: username, email, mobile, acceptTc
Form-data: profilePhoto (document). Optional: pincode, city, state, country, address1-3. docType in env for reference.
Update user profile (admin). Same body as Update Profile
Soft self-delete: user deletes own account. Account marked as deleted, sessions revoked, cannot log in again. Data retained for audit.

Admin only. Decrypt AES-GCM encrypted value (same format as JpaAttributeEncryptor). Use for PII fields: username_enc, email_enc, mobile_enc, etc. Body: { encryptedValue: "..." }. Returns { decryptedValue: "..." }.
Admin only. Get any user's profile with full decrypted (unmasked) PII.

item.name: Decrypt User Field (One by One, Admin)

variable.description: username, email, mobile, firstName, lastName, employeeId, pincode, city, state, country, address1, address2, address3, countryCode, dateOfBirth, gender, occupation, education, maritalStatus, profilePhotoUrl, linkedinUrl, facebookUrl, twitterUrl, instagramUrl, githubUrl, websiteUrl, preferences, activityPatterns, interests, bio, skills, languages, timezone, additionalInfo

request.description: Admin only. Decrypt one field at a time for any user. Call repeatedly for each field. Returns { field, decryptedValue }.
Admin audit logs. Query: userId, action, url, method, from, to (all optional)
Admin audit logs paginated. Query: page, size, sort (all optional)
TermsAndConditions: version, title, content (required). Optional: projectType, summary, language
Query: code, name (required); description, displayOrder (default: 0), createdBy (default: SYSTEM)
